description: **pd-xlab** is a collection of objects, tools, and integrations for **Pure Data (Pd)** focused on signal manipulation, statistics, Music Information Retrieval (MIR), and Python/Lua scripting. It includes `pd-partialtrack`, `pd-saf`, `pd-vamp`, `pd-server`, `pd-ambi`, `pd-upic`, maintained forks, and other tools.
